prompt: Call the church softball league championship like a WWE title match. Pastor Dave is 0-2 in championship games.
response:
*The lights dim over the Faith Community Fields! Fireworks explode over the backstop!*

**LADIES AND GENTLEMEN... WELCOME TO THE MAIN EVENT OF THE EVENING!**

THIS is the church softball league CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH... and OH, the STAKES have never been HIGHER!

In one dugout... the challenger... a man who has TASTED championship glory TWICE... and TWICE had it RIPPED from his grasp! He's been to the mountaintop, folks, but he's never planted the flag! Weighing in with two heartbreaking losses and a congregation full of DOUBTERS... "THE PRAYING MANTIS"... PASTOOOOOR... DAAAAAAVE!

*Crowd erupts, casserole dishes clanging in the stands*

BUT WAIT! You can talk about redemption arcs all you want, but the demons Pastor Dave faces tonight aren't spiritual, folks — THEY'RE HISTORICAL! Zero and two! ZERO AND TWO in the big one! They say the third time's the charm, but in THIS league, third time might just be THIRD STRIKE!

His hands are SHAKING at the plate! You can see it! The man preaches about faith every Sunday, but does he BELIEVE?! Does he believe in HIMSELF?!

*Announcer voice drops to a gravelly whisper*

Folks... they say Pastor Dave has been in the batting cages every night after Wednesday Bible study. They say he's got a NEW swing. A NEW mindset. Deacon Larry told me — and I quote — "Dave's different this year."

BUT IS DIFFERENT ENOUGH?!

Will Pastor Dave finally exorcise the ghosts of championships past?! Or will he walk back to that fellowship hall, ZERO AND THREE, condemned to another year of Greg from First Baptist bringing it up at EVERY interfaith potluck?!

THERE'S ONLY ONE WAY TO FIND OUT!

**LET'S!! PLAY!! BALL!!**

*Pyro budget: one (1) sparkler held by the youth pastor*
